title: What dictates soft clay-like lithium superionic conductor formation from rigid salts mixture.
summary: DeepMD simulations implicate molecular units in mechanical softness; spectroscopy supports their formation. This explains previously synthesized conductors rather than discovering their original synthesis.
organization: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory; University of California, Berkeley
